import json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.colors as mcolors
import numpy as np

with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

platforms = data['streaming_rankings']['platforms']
quarters = [d['quarter'] for d in data['streaming_rankings']['data']]

colors = {
    'Netflix': '#E50914',
    'Amazon Prime Video': '#00A8E1',
    'Spotify': '#1DB954',
    'Disney+': '#113CCF',
    'Apple TV+': '#000000',
    'HBO Max': '#B535F6',
    'YouTube Premium': '#FF0000',
    'Hulu': '#1CE783'
}

rank_data = {}
for p in platforms:
    rank_data[p] = [data['streaming_rankings']['data'][i].get(p) for i in range(len(quarters))]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(16, 8))

for platform in platforms:
    x_vals = []
    y_vals = []
    for i, q in enumerate(quarters):
        rank = rank_data[platform][i]
        if rank is not None:
            x_vals.append(i)
            y_vals.append(rank)

    ax.plot(x_vals, y_vals, color=colors[platform], linewidth=2.5, label=platform, alpha=0.9)
    ax.scatter(x_vals[0], y_vals[0], color=colors[platform], s=80, zorder=5)
    ax.scatter(x_vals[-1], y_vals[-1], color=colors[platform], s=80, zorder=5)

    ax.annotate(platform, (x_vals[0], y_vals[0]), textcoords="offset points",
                xytext=(-8, 0), ha='right', va='center', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold',
                color=colors[platform])
    ax.annotate(platform, (x_vals[-1], y_vals[-1]), textcoords="offset points",
                xytext=(8, 0), ha='left', va='center', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold',
                color=colors[platform])

ax.set_yticks([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8])
ax.set_yticklabels(['1st', '2nd', '3rd', '4th', '5th', '6th', '7th', '8th'])
ax.set_xticks(range(len(quarters)))
ax.set_xticklabels(quarters, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylim(8.5, 0.5)
ax.set_xlim(-1, len(quarters))

ax.set_xlabel('Quarter', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_ylabel('Rank Position', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_title('Streaming Platform Subscriber Rankings\nQ1 2019 – Q1 2025 (Rank 1 = Most Subscribers)',
             fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=20)

ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

legend = ax.legend(loc='lower right', ncol=2, fontsize=9, framealpha=0.9, title='Platforms')
legend.get_title().set_fontweight('bold')

ax.text(0.02, 0.02, 'Lower rank = more subscribers',
        transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=8, style='italic', alpha=0.7)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
plt.close()
